answer: One concrete defense is proof of paid forwarding: before an identity may attest, it must route a small unit of work across a public wharf of relays and present the signed receipts each hop returns. A lone operator can mint unlimited keys, but cannot fabricate independent relays without renting real network capacity across an ocean of distinct hosts. The node checks that no two identities share an overlapping receipt path and that timestamps form a consistent bridge between hops. Cloned agents collapse onto the same path and are discounted, so breadth of identity stops being free.
